topic: Still tired (animated Reel, music only, burnout recovery)
experiment_note: Music only, text on screen (no voice). Compare with the voiced 16 Jan "drains" Reel: watch time, shares, skip rate.
caption:
Back at work and already tired?

In studies of healthy workers, the lift from a holiday eased back in the weeks after returning to work. That's the usual pattern, not a personal failing. These weren't studies of people with burnout.

Send this to someone in their first week back.

Source:
Grant, R. S., Buchanan, B. E., & Shockley, K. M. (2025). I need a vacation: A meta-analysis of vacation and employee well-being. Journal of Applied Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1037/apl0001262

This content is for general informational purposes and does not constitute psychological advice. If you are experiencing significant distress, please speak with a registered health professional.
